gbm_population_evidence.quote: Presumed diagnosis of glioblastoma IDH-wt (as per the 2021 WHO Classification of CNS Tumors)

candidate_evidence.quote: DOC1021 administered by injection near deep-cervical lymph nodes + pIFN adjuvant with standard of care treatment
Receive subcutaneous pIFN injections weekly for a total of 6 doses in parallel with the DOC1021 injections

candidate_flag.reason: pIFN is described as a vaccine adjuvant, not a registered intervention; whether it counts as an investigational candidate (vs part of the excluded vaccine regimen) decides S6.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: DOC1021 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)

role_evidence.quote: Double-loaded dendritic cell vaccine, loaded with tumor lysate and mRNA using proprietary method

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous dendritic cell vaccine loaded with tumour lysate and mRNA (DOC1021)

role_evidence.quote: DOC1021 administered by injection near deep-cervical lymph nodes + pIFN adjuvant with standard of care treatment
The goal of this clinical trial is to learn if DOC1021 + pIFN alongside standard of care (SOC) will improve survival in adult patients newly diagnosed with glioblastoma (IDH-wt).

agents.drug_class_hint: pegylated interferon (type not specified), immunomodulatory cytokine used as vaccine adjuvant

flag.reason: Described only as adjuvant to the dendritic cell vaccine; may be considered part of the excluded vaccine regimen rather than a candidate.

role_evidence.quote: Take filgrastim subcutaneously x 5 doses and subsequently undergo a leukapheresis collection

agents.drug_class_hint: G-CSF, mobilisation before leukapheresis for cell product manufacture

role_evidence.quote: SOC concomitant temozolomide during radiation and adjuvant temozolomide after radiation

source_quote.quote: Eligibility will be confirmed after surgery when diagnosis of glioblastoma IDH-wt confirmed prior to randomization.

coder_notes: DOC1021 dendritic cell vaccine is an excluded intervention type. pIFN (not expanded in the record; presumably pegylated interferon) is given weekly alongside the vaccine only in the experimental arm and is not a registered intervention; coded as candidate by analogy with 'checkpoint inhibitor + vaccine', but flagged uncertain because the record frames it as an adjuvant. Filgrastim is used for leukapheresis mobilisation (supportive, R6 analogue). IDH-wt is a diagnostic criterion, not candidate-matched. Registered comparator arm is ACTIVE_COMPARATOR (SOC).
